place.poi_name: Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre
place.summary: Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre functions primarily as a connector in Hong Kong's visitor network. Its strongest observed source market is PH. It receives notable inbound connections from Hong Kong International Airport. Visitors often continue to Hong Kong Disneyland. Its observed experience trails the category average, despite existing visitor demand.

opportunity_cards.title: Frequent companion: Hong Kong International Airport
opportunity_cards.detail: Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre frequently appears alongside Hong Kong International Airport, suggesting cross-promotion or route packaging potential.

opportunity_cards.title: Strong onward link to Victoria Peak
opportunity_cards.detail: Visitors often continue from Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre to Victoria Peak, with relatively strong journey experience.

opportunity_cards.title: High visibility, weaker experience
opportunity_cards.detail: Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre draws meaningful traffic but performs below its category average on experience.
